sourceObservation.method: Fresh sport/year/brand/program selector reads and full checklist downloads. Product-guide, exact release-date and exhaustive numbering reconciliation remain incomplete.

notes: All 7,634 rows from the official Panini CSV export are retained, including all original columns, literal card-set parallel names and SEQUENCE values. Empty numbering is not an estimate.
